10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:ce219929-9c21-4d.title: System Operations Engineer - AI Trainer - Freelance - 8-20hrs/week - Remote
10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:ce219929-9c21-4d.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you a seasoned professional in systems operations and automation, eager to help shape the next generation of artificial intelligence? Join 10x Team as a Freelance System Operations Engineer – AI Trainer and leverage your expertise to build smarter AI models while working flexibly and remotely. About Us: 10x Team connects skilled freelancers with leading AI labs, collaborating to advance the capabilities of AI systems. We are seeking experienced system operations engineers based in the EU or UK to review, refine, and train AI to better understand and address real-world operational challenges. Key Responsibilities: - Review and improve AI-generated content and recommendations related to system operations, automation, and reliability - Evaluate technical accuracy and practicality of AI-driven operational scenarios and workflows - Develop real-world examples, use cases, and risk assessments from your domain experience - Create scenario variations for different operational roles—engineers, admins, leads - Identify weaknesses, inefficiencies, and overlooked risks in AI outputs, providing actionable feedback - Directly contribute to the way AI models reason about operations and automation challenges About You: - Experienced system operations engineer, SRE, DevOps specialist, or operations lead with a proven track record in managing and automating complex IT systems - Based in the EU or UK - Deep expertise in modern system operations approaches, automation tools, and best practices for operational excellence - Methodical, proactive, and effective at delivering clear, constructive feedback - Available 8–20 hours per week and reliable in remote communication Why Join 10x Team? - Flexible, project-based freelance work—100% remote - Help advance AI's understanding of complex operations and automation - Free access to the 10x Team AI Academy for continuous development - Structured onboarding, concise project briefs, and a collaborative freelance network How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Help lead the future of AI-driven system operations—apply today! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

Meade, Maryland JOB DESCRIPTION: Provides Network support that requires system level design, architecture or enterprise security and security boundaries, datacenter virtualization, CAN/MAN/LAN infrastructure packet capture software, TCP/IP protocol stack, routing/switching protocols, stateful firewalls, and L3/L4 access controls. • (U) Cisco IOS, CatOS, NxOS, filter and access control, Ciscoworks, TACACS+, ASA, FWSM, HP Openview, Cisco routers, Cisco Switches, F5/Cisco load balancers, Infiniband, Juniper, FiberChannel (FC) SAN, and VPN (IPSEC) • (U) Physical installation and configuration and troubleshooting of network routers, switches, load balancers and security devices. • (U) Strong knowledge of TCP/IP protocol stack and routing and switching protocols. • (U) Strong working knowledge of L2/L3 protocols. • (U) Strong working knowledge of stateful firewalls, and L3 access controls. • (U) Working knowledge of Atlassian Tool Suite. • (U) Able to support on-call requirements. • (U) Able to work in live call environment and utilize remedy and/or other ticketing system to track tasking. • (U) Virtualization products; VMWare and Solaris containers. distro-distro:lever:2c880540-ddca-4360-a.description: We are a proud work-from-office company. If you're ready to work on-site in a dynamic, global company, we'd love to hear from you. About Us Vensure Employer Solutions is the largest privately held organization in the HR technology and service sector, providing a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including HR/HCM technology, managed services, and global business process outsourcing (BPO). The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. As a "One Employer Solution” headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Vensure helps thousands of businesses streamline and grow their operations with custom strategies that benefit both employers and employees. Find out more by visiting www.vensure.com . Position Summary The HCM Business Consultant is responsible for identifying and cultivating new business opportunities through networking, channel partners and self-generated opportunities. This role involves executing aggressive prospecting strategies to gain access to key decision makers within a prospective client's organization. The Business Consultant maintains ownership of the entire sales cycle, including post-sale and implementation processes. The Business Consultant is also responsible for maintaining an accurate sales pipeline and forecast, and achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals as assigned by the sales leadership team. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:e38a1928-8ce.title: Inside Sales Manager
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:e38a1928-8ce.description: Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses. We help companies build high-performing teams across executive assistance, administrative support, customer support, sales support, recruiting, operations, and other critical business functions. The Role We’re looking for a hands-on Inside Sales Manager to own the follow-up and mid-funnel layer of our inbound sales engine while raising the quality and consistency of how our entire sales floor sells. You will lead this function, strengthen the systems and processes behind it, coach the team, and ensure every qualified opportunity is managed with discipline and urgency. You will also help establish stronger sales standards across the organization through coaching, performance management, process improvement, and the thoughtful use of sales technology. This is a builder’s role, not a caretaker’s. You will have a team, a modern sales tech stack, and clear revenue and performance targets tied directly to your ownership. Salary: PHP 90,000 to PHP 110,000 per month, plus On-Target Earnings (OTE) Schedule: Pacific Time
responsibilities: What You’ll Own:
Team Leadership
Manage and develop the inbound follow-up team, including SDRs and Sales Associates
Conduct regular 1:1s, coach performance, and hire as the team scales
Own the pairing model between Sales Associates and Account Executives
Establish cadence standards, ownership rules, and CRM hygiene expectations
Manage the Sales Trainer and own onboarding and ramp-up for all new sales hires
Follow-Up and Mid-Funnel Conversion
Design, write, and A/B test follow-up sequences across email and chat
Use reply rate, re-engagement rate, and conversion as your primary scorecards
Build and manage the no-show recovery motion for cancellations and missed demos
Turn missed and cancelled demos into rebooked conversations
Build and run reactivation campaigns for aged and closed-lost opportunities
Reduce stage-to-stage drop-off across the funnel, beginning with the weakest-performing stage
Channel Partner Lead Management
Oversee the handling of leads and opportunities generated through channel partnerships
Establish clear ownership, follow-up, and reporting standards for partner-sourced opportunities
Track channel partner performance and evaluate its effectiveness as a source of new business
Sales Quality and Coaching
Review recorded calls and demos using a written sales scorecard
Maintain a fixed monthly call-review coverage target for every representative
Coach Account Executives on discovery, objection handling, urgency, and securing second calls
Run regular calibration sessions to ensure consistent scoring and coaching standards
Join live deals when a representative needs support moving an opportunity forward
Knowledge and Compliance
Own the sales knowledge base as the company’s single source of truth
Maintain the content that powers our AI sales chat assistant
Establish a regular review cadence so customer-facing information remains accurate and current
Ensure claims made by sales representatives and automated channels are accurate and compliant
What You’ll Be Measured On
Demo no-show and cancellation recovery rate
Customer response-time SLA
Deal conversion rate
Sales cycle length
Average contract value per deal
Follow-up reply rate
Touches-per-deal compliance
Second-call booking rate
Stage-to-stage funnel conversion
Demo-to-close rate
Revenue recovered from aged and closed-lost pipeline
Call scorecard coverage, including documented coaching feedback for every representative
qualifications: Requirements
At least 4 years of experience in inside sales, sales development, revenue operations, or a similar commercial role
At least 2 years of experience managing or coaching a sales team
Proven experience improving follow-up, pipeline conversion, show rates, or sales-cycle performance
Strong understanding of inbound sales funnels, lead management, and mid-funnel conversion
Experience coaching sales representatives on discovery, objection handling, urgency, and deal progression
Ability to review sales calls, identify performance gaps, and provide clear, actionable feedback
Hands-on experience building sales sequences across email, chat, SMS, or other follow-up channels
Strong CRM discipline and experience working with platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce
Comfortable using data to diagnose funnel problems, set targets, and manage performance
Strong written and verbal English communication skills
Willingness and ability to work Pacific Time hours
Preferred
Experience managing both SDRs or Sales Associates and Account Executives
Experience owning sales onboarding, training, and rep ramp-up programs
Experience building no-show recovery, closed-lost reactivation, or aged-pipeline campaigns
Familiarity with AI-enabled sales tools, conversation intelligence, and sales automation platforms
Experience working in a high-growth startup, SaaS, staffing, outsourcing, or technology-enabled services company
Experience managing leads generated through channel partnerships
Familiarity with compliance, sales claims management, and maintaining a customer-facing knowledge base

lightfield-lightfield:ashbyhq:b7b4cc0a-f.title: Head of Content
lightfield-lightfield:ashbyhq:b7b4cc0a-f.description: ABOUT LIGHTFIELD Lightfield is an AI-native CRM that assembles itself from your email, calendar, and meetings. It captures every interaction and turns it into organized context: accounts, tasks, follow-ups, and insights, so nothing slips through the cracks. We’re rethinking CRM from first principles. Instead of forcing teams to maintain rigid systems, Lightfield learns from how companies actually work, adapting, automating, and surfacing the insight that drives growth. We’re building the CRM platform we always wished existed: fast, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. The market agrees. Over 5,000 companies have used Lightfield since we launched in November, making us the fastest-adopted product in our category. We are backed by Greylock, Lightspeed, and Coatue, and our founders previously built Tome, a generative AI presentation product used by over 25 million people. Before Lightfield, our team worked on Llama, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Pinterest, Google, and Salesforce. Our best growth channel is people telling other people about Lightfield and most of them arrived through a founder's post, a customer's recommendation, or a story that traveled. That's not an accident, but it isn't yet a machine. We’re hiring a Head of Content to build the machine - and to make Lightfield the default answer when someone asks how modern GTM should work whether they’re asking Google or asking AI. Almost nobody owns both of those yet. You would. You’ll be the engine behind our founders’ voices in the market, turn our most vocal customers into stories the industry repeats, and build the search and answer-engine presence underneat all of it. This is a builder's role with a wide surface area: founder thought leadership, customer stories, SEO and AEO, our newsletters, and a creator program that puts Lightfield in front of the audiences that matter. You'll work directly with the founders and hire the team as the function grows. This role reports directly to our Head of GTM. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Be the engine behind our founders' voices. Our founders have earned real credibility building and selling AI products. You'll turn that into a consistent, high-signal presence — posts, essays, podcasts, talks, and video — with a process that makes it sustainable rather than dependent on inspiration striking. - Turn customer outcomes into compelling stories that build our brand. Build a repeatable pipeline for customer stories — sourcing, interviewing, writing, and distributing them across formats. Word-of-mouth is our strongest growth lever, and it runs on stories worth retelling. - Own SEO and AEO. You'll own traditional organic search and the newer discipline of getting Lightfield accurately represented in AI answers — structured content, citable source material, and the technical foundations behind both. - Scale our creator program. Identify and partner with the creators, operators, and practitioners whose audiences trust them, and build real relationships rather than one-off sponsorships. - Build the content operating system. Editorial calendar, briefs, standards, freelance and agency bench, distribution playbook, and the analytics to know what's working. You'll make quality repeatable. - Scale output through contractors and agencies. Bring on writers, editors, and content operators as we scale, while staying hands-on enough to write the piece that has to be perfect. - Partner with growth marketing to drive growth. Use data on what content is driving the most impressions and pipeline to guide content strategy. WHO YOU ARE - You're an exceptional writer and editor with taste and standards. You have range — a founder's LinkedIn post, a technical explainer, a customer story, and a newsletter all sound right coming from you. Your portfolio shows real artifacts, not decks about artifacts, and you'd rather ship less and have it matter. - You've ghostwritten for a strong voice before. You can capture how someone thinks and sounds, and produce work they'd have wr

pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:6d86a24c-341d-46c.title: Founding Sales Lead
pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:6d86a24c-341d-46c.description: ABOUT TEACHSHARE TeachShare is on a mission to simplify the daily instructional process so teachers can focus on the moments that matter. To do this, we are building a self-improving, easily digestible, daily plan for teachers that is grounded in their student's concept mastery, along with their institution's framework and curriculum. We are the only Plan, Teach, Assess platform for K-12. TeachShare is used by teachers across 60,000 schools. We got here with a full-time team that is entirely engineers. For two years we've been heads-down on product depth, and the bet is paying off: we're growing fast month over month, and our last two months have been our best ever. THE ROLE Every deal so far has been closed by the founders. We have real inbound from schools & districts of teachers that use and love us. What we don't have is anyone whose whole job is turning that demand into a real pipeline. That's you. You're our first sales leader and our first go-to-market hire. This is a founding role. You'll take what's worked from founder-led sales and build the entire sales function from scratch: process, tooling, messaging, all of it. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the full sales cycle with schools and districts, from first conversation to signed contract - Run the motion that's already working and make it repeatable without you or us in every call - Build the systems that don't exist yet: CRM hygiene, outreach, qualification, pricing conversations, contracting - Get fluent in how districts actually buy: budget cycles, purchase orders, RFQs, vendor registration, committees, pilots, and partnerships - Feed what you hear in the field directly into positioning and roadmap, working side by side with the founders - Lay the groundwork for the team that comes after you: the playbook, the onboarding, the first hires WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 3+ years in a quota-carrying sales role, with B2B or B2G sales cycle experience (EdTech a plus, not required) - Self-directed. You're comfortable operating without an existing playbook, because there isn't one yet - Genuinely interested in education and making educators' lives easier, not just selling into it - Resilient with setbacks. You treat a pitch that doesn't land as data and iterate quickly - Operator mindset. You're as comfortable designing a process as running one - Optimistic & a someone who hustles. WHY TEACHSHARE Work with the founding team and have real influence and ownership over product and go-to-market. A product teachers already pull into their schools for you. And the chance to build a sales org's foundation from the ground up instead of inheriting someone else's. The work matters, too. We're fostering classroom cohesion for hundreds of thousands of teachers and hundreds of schools and districts. You'd be the person who brings it to thousands more. We are backed by the best investors in education - Reach Capital, with support from Pear VC. Compensation: $90-200k + OTE & meaningful ownership. Range depends on experience and location.
